baseline_models.focus_anchor: السقف at word 1 is modified by المرفوع at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: A covering is physically displaced upward, producing an overhead boundary and a bounded space below.

activation_trace.role: A high roof or covering supplies the overhead boundary.
Physical lifting supplies the upward displacement that makes the boundary overhead.

changed_reading.before: The oath names an unspecified lofty object.
changed_reading.after: The oath names a deliberately elevated covering whose position creates a world beneath it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun السقف at word 1 names a roofed shelter, while المرفوع at word 2 gives it clearance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The roof's elevation is functional: it turns cover into inhabitable interior rather than merely adding altitude.

activation_trace.role: The roofed shelter supplies an enclosed place rather than a bare upper surface.
Physical elevation supplies the clearance by which shelter becomes usable space.

changed_reading.before: The roof is viewed only as an object above.
changed_reading.after: The raised roof is read through the habitable and protective interior it makes possible below.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: السقف at word 1 can be a broad roofing member, and المرفوع at word 2 marks that member as lifted into place.
baseline_models.mechanism: Breadth, ribs, planks, and lifting produce a structural span: the focus can evoke an assembled load-bearing member, not a featureless ceiling.

activation_trace.role: The broad roofing slab and analogous ribs or splints supply a material spanning member.
Lifting places that structural member above the space it spans.

changed_reading.before: The roof is a smooth, static surface.
changed_reading.after: The roof is an elevated structural span whose members bear and organize an overhead load.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: المرفوع at word 2 permits rank and public announcement alongside physical elevation, while السقف at word 1 remains the visible upper object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Elevation can make the covering prominent in both rank and visibility, so the roof can function as a conspicuous sign rather than neutral scenery.

activation_trace.role: The high covering supplies a visible upper referent.
High rank adds prominence rather than mere distance.
Publicizing a report lets elevation function as display or proclamation.

changed_reading.after: Raised also makes the roof a prominent, publicly exhibited upper sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: المرفوع at word 2 can denote withholding from release, attached to the covering named at word 1.
baseline_models.mechanism: Raising can be a state of retention, so the overhead cover may be carrying or holding back a payload rather than simply occupying height.

activation_trace.role: The covering supplies a retaining boundary above.
Withholding milk from release supplies the unusual but explicit retention mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The raised state is exhausted by height.
changed_reading.after: The raised state may also be suspension or retention: something remains held above and unreleased.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath chain moves through a limit, an aligned inscription, an opened surface, an inhabited shelter, the focus roof, and a filled expanse. Repeated boundaries, planes, and enclosures turn the roof into one layer of an ordered world architecture.

activation_trace.role: The high covering supplies the central upper layer in the sequence.
Physical elevation positions that layer vertically.
A limit at which one stops or crosses supplies the architecture's outer boundary.
An aligned written row supplies an ordered planar layer.
Opening and spreading turns the written layer into an exposed surface.
The dwelling supplies an inhabited interior adjacent to the focus roof.
Removing ruin by building makes the adjacent house an actively constituted habitat.
Filling with water supplies a lower or neighboring contained expanse.

structural_cues: 52:1-6 places the focus between an inhabited house and a filled sea inside one uninterrupted oath sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive limits, planes, shelter, roof, and contained expanse; I infer that their order composes layered architecture around the focus. A live alternative is that the oath objects remain independent witnesses with no shared spatial assembly.

changed_reading.before: The raised roof is an isolated cosmic object.
changed_reading.after: The raised roof is a load-bearing layer within an inhabited, inscribed, and bounded world-system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The participial raised state acquires a live inverse. What is above can surge, be displaced, shed a piece, and fall; the roof therefore reads as a maintained load-state whose stability can reverse, not as altitude fixed by definition.

activation_trace.role: The broad roofing member supplies a load capable of movement or failure.
Physical lifting supplies the initial upward state that later motion can reverse.
Falling and then becoming fixed supplies the direct downward counter-motion.
Warding off an unwanted thing supplies the unavailable resistance to the reversal.
Oscillation and wave-like motion makes the sky-roof dynamically unstable.
Removal and displacement of mountains extends instability to the supporting landscape.
A detached piece of a body or sky supplies a discrete failed portion of the upper layer.
Downward falling explicitly reverses the focus's elevation.
Material piled layer upon layer explains the observers' alternative load-model of cloud.

structural_cues: The later clause in 52:44 makes a piece of the sky the grammatical subject of falling after 52:5 has called the roof raised.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upward focus state, later sky oscillation, landscape displacement, and a falling sky-piece; I infer a reversible structural load. The live alternative is that the raised roof and later collapse imagery describe separate moments without implying ongoing support between them.

changed_reading.before: Raised means permanently and serenely high.
changed_reading.after: Raised names a presently maintained condition whose intelligible inverse is release, displacement, and collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The withholding branch of رفع is activated by a filled or ignited sea and by cloud drawn together and piled. The roof can therefore be imagined as a retaining layer with an ambiguous water-or-fire payload held from release.

activation_trace.role: The overhead covering supplies the boundary of a possible upper store.
Withholding milk from release supplies retention as a live sense of being raised.
The wide mass of water supplies reservoir material.
Filling with water supplies one possible state of the stored payload.
Kindling fire preserves a competing fiery payload instead of collapsing the branch ambiguity.
A cloud drawn across the sky supplies visibly suspended upper material.
Piling one thing over another supplies accumulation against the retaining layer.

structural_cues: 52:6 follows the roof with a sea whose branch inventory polarizes filling, emptying, and ignition; 52:44 later supplies suspended piled cloud.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retention in رفع, a filled or ignited expanse, and accumulated cloud; I infer an upper retaining function and leave the payload unresolved. The live alternative is that sea, roof, and cloud remain unrelated media and that the withholding branch is only lexical distance.

changed_reading.before: The roof is empty height above the observer.
changed_reading.after: The roof may be a retaining interface, holding an accumulated upper payload whose eventual release remains latent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questions about control, a stair, overhearing, compelling authority, possession of the hidden, writing, and judgment turn the upper cover into an access boundary. Elevation regulates who may cross, receive information, or present a claim from above.

activation_trace.role: The high covering supplies the boundary between lower and upper domains.
Bringing a person or case before authority turns upward movement into jurisdictional presentation.
The controlling overseer supplies the disputed claim to command the upper boundary.
A stair or means supplies the proposed crossing route.
Hearing supplies the information supposedly obtained after access.
Compelling proof supplies the credential demanded from the alleged listener.
What is screened from sight supplies the protected informational domain beyond the boundary.
Writing supplies the alleged record brought back from hidden access.
Judgment supplies the legitimate authority against which rival access claims are measured.

structural_cues: 52:37-41 repeats interrogative claims of possession and access, with the stair in 52:38 giving the upper boundary a concrete crossing mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a high cover followed by control, stair, hearing, proof, hidden knowledge, and writing; I infer that the cover functions as an access-control boundary. The live alternative is that the stair is rhetorical without any intended backward activation of the roof.

changed_reading.before: The raised roof only separates above from below spatially.
changed_reading.after: The raised roof also marks a jurisdictional and epistemic threshold: access upward requires authorization, evidence, and accountable transmission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The broad upper surface is materially analogized to an opened folio, while the publicity branch of رفع makes it an exhibit. Writing, parchment, publication, demanded discourse, clarification, seeing, and contested naming make the roof a surface to be read as evidence.

activation_trace.role: The broad slab supplies a page-like material surface without ceasing to be a roof.
Announcing a report makes the elevated surface publicly legible.
Ordered letters and the written object supply textual material.
Written parchment supplies the thin receiving surface for inscription.
A published writing supplies disclosure to readers.
A newly communicated report supplies the demanded counter-text.
Clarifying by speech or sign supplies the evidentiary function of the display.
Sight supplies direct reception of the upper exhibit.
A thing's signification makes their spoken cloud-label a rival reading of what is seen.

structural_cues: The oath's written and opened material precedes the roof, while 52:44 stages observers seeing an upper event and assigning it a competing interpretation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a broad roof, publication within رفع, opened writing, evidentiary speech, sight, and contested naming; I infer a page-to-roof material analogy and a readable cosmic exhibit. The live alternative is that textual and visual signs remain parallel rather than materially mapped onto one another.

changed_reading.before: The roof is seen but carries no communicative function.
changed_reading.after: The raised roof can be read as an opened public folio: a visible sign whose meaning observers may receive or deliberately relabel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering bifurcates into protection and occlusion. Gardens and the protected pearl make concealment preservative; covering the truth and mis-seeing the falling sky make it epistemically obstructive. The focus roof can therefore shelter and screen at once.

activation_trace.role: The roofed shelter supplies covering as protection.
Inner discernment supplies the capacity needed to read beyond a surface cover.
A garden hidden by trees supplies beneficial enclosure.
Protective concealment supplies preservation of what is valuable.
Covering supplies the same operation in a morally ambiguous form.
Hiding truth gives covering its obstructive epistemic direction.
Actual seeing supplies the test at which protection can become misrecognition.

structural_cues: The sequence contrasts protected interiors in 52:17-24 with covered truth in 52:42 and a misread upper sight in 52:44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several literal and cognitive forms of covering; I infer that the focus roof activates their shared interface function. The live alternative is that protection and denial are merely homonymous branches with no backward pressure on السقف.

changed_reading.after: The raised roof is a bifacial cover: it preserves an interior while also making possible an obscured or misread exterior.

context_deltas.mechanism: A roof creates one bounded interior; the garden sequence then populates such an interior through rows, pairing, attached descendants, retained individual pledges, protected attendants, and mutual facing. Shared enclosure organizes plurality without erasing personal accountability.

activation_trace.role: The roofed shelter supplies a common bounded interior.
Alignment on a level line supplies spatial order among occupants.
Joining one thing as the companion of another supplies relational pairing.
A later one reaching what is ahead supplies the joining of generations.
A document held against a right preserves individual liability inside communal joining.
Protective covering supplies the condition of preserved service within the enclosure.
Face-to-face orientation supplies reciprocal social geometry.

structural_cues: 52:20-25 moves from arranged couches and pairs through joined descendants and individual pledges to protected attendants and mutual facing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered relations and the focus supplies an interiorizing roof; I infer that the roof can function as the spatial condition for gathered but differentiated community. The live alternative is that the garden's social layout does not reactivate the earlier oath object.

changed_reading.before: The raised roof encloses undifferentiated space.
changed_reading.after: The raised roof can define a common interior whose architecture supports rows, pairs, lineage, reciprocal facing, and continuing individual responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Building away ruin, nurturing to completion, warding harm, watchful care, and secure workmanship recast the shelter as maintained order. The roof is not only erected once; its habitable function is continuously preserved.

activation_trace.role: The roofed shelter supplies the habitat that requires preservation.
Removing ruin through construction supplies active maintenance.
Repair, nurture, and completion supplies the sustaining agency behind order.
Warding off harm supplies the shelter's protective outcome.
The eye of preservation and care supplies continuous oversight.
Secure and exact workmanship supplies structural integrity.

structural_cues: The inhabited house immediately before the focus and the command to wait under watchful care near the surah's end frame the roof with maintenance rather than mere fabrication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies habitation, repair, nurture, protection, oversight, and secure construction; I infer that these are functional supports of the focus shelter. The live alternative is that divine care concerns persons only and should not be projected onto the roof's stability.

changed_reading.before: The roof is a completed artifact left standing on its own.
changed_reading.after: The raised roof can signify continuously maintained habitable order, secured through care, repair, and warding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing schedule of rising, night, and the stars' recession turns the overhead cover into a temporal display. The raised roof not only bounds space; its visible changes index when embodied praise occurs.

activation_trace.role: The high covering supplies the visible overhead field on which time is marked.
Elevation makes that field continuously available above the observer.
The proper time of an act supplies explicit scheduling.
Bodily standing supplies the observer's repeated posture beneath the roof.
Night's darkness supplies one temporal phase of the overhead display.
The ending and passing of a phase supplies temporal recession.
Visible stars supply the moving markers whose retreat closes the interval.

structural_cues: 52:48-49 coordinates praise with standing, night, and the recession of stars, combining bodily and celestial timing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an overhead field and a closing sequence of timed posture and stellar recession; I infer that the roof can function as a celestial clock-face. The live alternative is that the time markers schedule worship without modifying the earlier roof image.

changed_reading.before: The roof is only a spatial boundary.
changed_reading.after: The raised roof can also be a temporal field whose changing lights coordinate recurrent embodied action below.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins distant construction and medical-tool branches: the focus's broad roofing member explicitly includes splint sticks, and 52:40 supplies mending a crooked fracture. It remains anchored in السقف at word 1 and is strengthened by motion and secure workmanship; render it only as an exploratory material analogy, not as a lexical gloss or a claim that the sky is literally injured.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السقف at word 1 through its broad slab, rib, and splint-stick branch.

activation_trace.role: The broad roofing member and explicit splint analogy supply a brace.
Oscillation supplies the unstable body that could require bracing.
Setting a crooked fracture supplies the repair mechanism.
Secure workmanship supplies the brace's stabilizing result.

changed_reading.before: The roof merely covers an already stable world.
changed_reading.after: The roof can be carried as a world-splint: an elevated brace that holds a mobile order in alignment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates the shackle-lifting cord within رفع and treats the roof as an attachment point. It remains anchored in المرفوع at word 2 and gains a coherent load mechanism from pledge and burden branches; render it as a juridical-mechanical analogy, not as a claim that the ayah names literal chains or automatic release.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المرفوع at word 2 through the shackle-lifting cord branch, with the roofing member at word 1 as a possible suspension point.

activation_trace.role: The broad structural member supplies a possible point of suspension.
A cord that lifts a bound person's shackle supplies the explicit leverage image.
A pledge held against a right supplies juridical binding.
An imposed heavy load supplies what the suspension mechanism bears.

changed_reading.before: The roof's height is purely descriptive.
changed_reading.after: Height becomes leverage: the raised member can figure the point from which a binding load is held, managed, or relieved.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus branch for height with bending or drooping is anatomically distant, so this cannot define سقف lexically. It remains anchored in word 1 and becomes mechanically coherent beside sky oscillation and a detached sky-piece; render it as a tentative image of a bowed or flexing vault, not as a settled cosmography.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: السقف at word 1 through the height-with-bending branch.

activation_trace.role: Height with bending or drooping supplies curvature and flexure.
Physical elevation keeps the curved member overhead.
Wave-like oscillation supplies dynamic flexing.
A detached sky-piece supplies the possible result of excessive strain.

changed_reading.before: The roof is imagined as a rigid flat plane.
changed_reading.after: The roof may be carried as a bowed vault under strain, capable of oscillating and shedding a fragment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates highness of voice within رفع and maps acoustics onto architecture. It remains directly anchored in المرفوع at word 2 and gains a sequence from severe sound to praise beneath the upper field; render it as a secondary acoustic resonance, not as a replacement for physical elevation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: المرفوع at word 2 through the highness-of-voice branch, attached to the covering at word 1.

activation_trace.role: The overhead covering supplies an acoustic canopy.
Highness of voice supplies sound as an alternative mode of elevation.
A severe striking sound supplies the canopy's overwhelming acoustic pole.
Praise opposed to blame supplies articulate human response.
Vocal worship and praise supplies recurrent sound beneath the roof.

changed_reading.before: Elevation is exclusively visual and spatial.
changed_reading.after: The raised roof can carry a secondary acoustic reading: a sounding canopy spanning catastrophic noise and measured praise.

strongest_changes: Later sky-motion and the falling sky-piece recast raised as a reversible load-state rather than permanent altitude.
The opening oath chain turns the roof into a layer of inhabited, inscribed, bounded, and filled world architecture.
The stair, overhearing, authority, hidden knowledge, and writing sequence activates the roof as a jurisdictional access boundary.
Writing, opening, seeing, and naming turn elevation into public display, while protection and denial preserve two opposed functions of covering.
summary.what_was_special: The two-word focus sustained several nonexclusive mechanisms: architectural span, sheltered interior, maintained load, retained payload, public evidence, access control, social ordering, temporal display, and contained structural or acoustic analogies. The trace keeps these readings coexisting instead of forcing one referent or one domain.
remaining_uncertainties: The oath items may compose one layered architecture, or they may remain independent witnesses whose adjacency only weakly activates the roof.
The withholding, publication, shackle-cord, and high-voice branches of رفع may be productive latent activations or overly distant from the participle's local use.
The falling sky-piece may directly reverse the raised roof, or it may be a later event that does not imply present structural tension.
The page, splint, clock-face, and acoustic-canopy models are material or functional analogies, not lexical replacements, and their downstream rendering needs explicit qualification.
